BiblicalUsage: Slander, as the psalm says thou sittest and speakest against thy brother, thou slanderest thine own mother's son, and this word is the slander the tongue speaks against its own kin.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that a tongue given to slander frames its own deceit, and God hears every stitch of it.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
